title: Custom RFID & NFC Manufacturer in China since 2008
summary: Proud Tek manufactures custom RFID tags, NFC stickers, smart cards, keyfobs, wristbands and readers from our Shenzhen operation. The catalog spans 191 SKU variants across 6 product families and ships globally with chip-level customization, partner-line encoding and a documentation pack — sample-based RoHS, REACH SVHC and CE test reports plus the lot's functional test report — on every PO.
heroPoints: Manufacturing since 2008, specializing in HF (NTAG, MIFARE, ICODE) and UHF (Monza, Higgs, UCODE) chip families.
Partner-line encoding, laser numbering and bespoke printing in Shenzhen.
Global shipping coverage via DHL, FedEx, EMS and sea-freight options on every shipment.

sections.title: Six product families, one supplier
sections.intro: Proud Tek concentrates the catalog around the chip-housing combinations buyers ask about most often. The same wet-inlay lines that print NFC review stickers for restaurants also produce UHF inlays for pharmaceutical serialization, so single-vendor procurement is realistic across multiple deployments.
bullets: RFID Tags: anti-metal, high-temperature, on-asset, embedded.
RFID Labels: wet inlays, dry inlays, pre-printed, RFID-on-paper.
RFID Readers: desktop, handheld, fixed-mount, USB, OEM modules.
RFID Cards: MIFARE, NTAG, EM, dual-frequency, hotel keys, transit.
RFID Keyfobs: access, membership, OEM credential replacements.
RFID Wristbands: silicone, fabric, woven, paper, Tyvek, RFID-textile.

sections.title: How an inquiry runs with Proud Tek
sections.intro: Buyers come to Proud Tek when they want a chip-level conversation, not catalog forwarding. Five things define how an inquiry runs.
bullets: Manufacturing partner: specification, chip sourcing and quality control in-house; production on contracted partner lines in Shenzhen — BOM breakdown on request.
In-house engineering: we read chip datasheets, not just spec sheets, and we will tell you when a chip family is wrong for your reader.

Sample-first sales motion: standard samples free for qualified B2B buyers, prepared in 1 business day, with NDEF/UID encoding on request; you cover express freight, refunded against the first production order.

Documentation pack per shipment: sample-based RoHS, REACH SVHC and CE test reports (numbers on the certifications page), Certificate of Origin and the lot's functional test report; testing on your specification on request.
Reorder velocity: once a spec is locked, repeat orders ship in 10–14 days for stocked chip families.

sections.title: Where to start
sections.intro: Pick the entry point that matches the stage of your project. Buyers in research mode usually start with industries or comparisons; buyers ready to sample start with the contact path or product catalog directly.
bullets: If the application is locked → /industries/ → pick vertical → SKU recommendation set.
If chip family is locked → /products/all/ → filter by chip / environment.
If still shortlisting → /compare/ → narrow one ambiguous decision at a time.
If reader is locked → /compatibility/ → chip-family compatibility matrix.
If a sample brief is ready → /contact/ → industry-specific path.

faq.question: What is your minimum order quantity?
faq.answer: Standard MOQ for stocked chip families starts at 500 pieces for cards and 1,000 pieces for tags or labels. Sample orders below MOQ are available on a paid-sample basis when chip programming or housing customization is involved.

faq.question: Do you support OEM and white-label?
faq.answer: Yes. Most cards, keyfobs, wristbands and labels ship without Proud Tek branding by default. We support custom artwork, embossed numbering, laser engraving and bespoke packaging for resellers and integrators.

faq.question: How fast can samples arrive?
faq.answer: Standard samples are prepared in 1 business day and ship by DHL or FedEx from Shenzhen, typically arriving in 2–5 days; you cover the freight, refunded against your first production order. Custom shells, printing approvals or anti-metal lamination add 3–5 business days.

faq.question: What chip families do you stock?
faq.answer: HF/NFC: NTAG 213/215/216/424 DNA, MIFARE Classic 1k/4k, MIFARE Plus EV2, MIFARE DESFire EV2/EV3, MIFARE Ultralight C/EV1, ICODE SLIX, EM4100/4200/4305. UHF: Impinj Monza M730/M750/M770/M800, {chip:alien-higgs-3:name}/4/EC/9, {chip:nxp-ucode-7:name}/8/9. We can usually source other chip families on request with longer lead times.

faq.question: Do you provide compliance documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. Every shipment carries the sample-based RoHS, REACH SVHC and CE (EN 62311) test reports published with their numbers on the certifications page, a Certificate of Origin and the lot's functional test report. Reader devices ship with their own FCC, CE, MIC or CCC approval per device and market. Testing on your exact specification, or third-party reports from labs such as TÜV or SGS, can be commissioned per programme.
